doc.projectIntro: This quote covers an upgrade to Yuppiechef's connectivity across your Store (Westlake) and Warehouse (AA building) sites, on a 24-month contract. It replaces your existing three connectivity line items in full: the 100Mbps on-net link at the Store, the 100Mbps on-net link at the Warehouse, and the 50Mbps Liquid link at the Store. In their place, we're offering an upgraded 200Mbps on-net link at the Store and a single 500Mbps Liquid link covering both the Store and Warehouse. All prices exclude VAT (15%).

items.detail: Upgraded from 100Mbps. On Rocking's own network.
Replaces the existing 50Mbps Liquid link at the Store and the 100Mbps on-net link at the Warehouse — a single 500Mbps Liquid link covering both sites.
